capabilities: Uploads Markdown notes from watched folders to an AnythingLLM workspace
Replaces workspace embeddings when a note is edited, renamed or moved
Removes embeddings when a note is deleted or moved out of watched folders
Bulk syncs existing notes, single files or whole folders on demand
Shows per-file sync badges and checks whether remote documents still exist
disambiguation: Not two-way sync; it only pushes notes from Obsidian to an AnythingLLM workspace and never pulls content back.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. AnythingLLM can keep superseded uploaded source documents in its global storage because no public per-document delete endpoint is used. No analytics or telemetry.
problem: Notes kept in Obsidian stay outside an AnythingLLM workspace unless they are uploaded and re-embedded by hand each time they change.

relations.evidence: Automatically keep Markdown notes in selected Obsidian folders synchronized with an AnythingLLM workspace.

summary: Syncs Markdown notes from selected vault folders to an AnythingLLM workspace, uploading, re-embedding and removing them as notes change.
